text: Treat the locate_tooth box as a starting hypothesis, not a guarantee. Inspect its zoom_crop before diagnosis.
If off-center, too tight/loose, or showing a different tooth, use nudge_crop on the returned box and zoom_crop again. Corrections may be repeated.
dx_frac and dy_frac are fractions of the supplied box width and height; scale changes its size. Coordinates remain native-image coordinates.
Use patient FDI quadrants: 1 upper right, 2 upper left, 3 lower left, 4 lower right; positions 1 through 8. Do not substitute display left for patient left.
Caries and Deep Caries are distinct permitted output labels.
Inspect the returned tooth crop and improve contrast or windowing when density is unclear.
Radiographs contribute evidence about decay; clinical detection also uses examination. Do not infer symptoms or vitality from the image alone.

After verifying the tooth, inspect the crown and any suspected radiolucency, then use window_level or enhance_contrast if density is unclear; compare the suspected extent toward the pulp before choosing between the two permitted caries labels.

The ESE framework distinguishes deep from extremely deep dentinal lesions by their extent and remaining barrier to the pulp. This is clinical context, not an asserted numeric DENTEX annotation rule; do not add an Extremely Deep Caries output class.

Panoramic assessment is not proof of absence of proximal caries; the FDA/ADA selection guidance identifies bitewings as the efficient view for proximal lesions. Record the visible evidence rather than assuming a low-detail region is normal.
A patient may have multiple findings; report all investigated findings.
For a clinically healthy dentition with no identifiable target pathologies, return final_answer: [].
The verifier rejects a nonempty candidate final_answer when the supplied ground truth is empty; ground truth is verifier-only and must never be exposed to the policy.
Screen all four quadrants, retain the full-image context, and investigate suspicious regions before returning an empty target-findings list. Do not stop the survey after confirming one normal crop.
Use window_level for unclear density, denoise for a noisy view and contrast enhancement for low contrast; verify any investigated crop still shows the intended tooth.

An empty target-findings list is not a claim that panoramic imaging excludes every dental disease. The FDA/ADA guidance uses clinical context and selected intraoral views, including bitewings for proximal caries, rather than treating a panoramic survey as a universal negative test.
The dataset label Impacted is normalized for evaluation; the agent prompt permits Impacted Tooth.
Locate the requested tooth and inspect its crop before diagnosing. A detector error is not a clinical finding.
AAOMS defines impaction as inability to erupt into a normal oral position, potentially related to space, abnormal position or pathology. A tooth missing from a crop is not evidence of impaction.

Inspect the localized tooth and adjacent anatomy with the full panoramic context retained; AAOMS notes that panoramic imaging is commonly used but radiographs may not fully establish position or the surgical approach. Do not infer a treatment indication from this classification output.
If locate_tooth fails for the requested tooth, do not repeat the same failed detection; inspect a localized neighboring region or improve visibility with the existing contrast/window tools.
Periapical Lesion is a permitted output label.
The existing example inspects the root apex and compares the mirrored side before committing.
Verify the requested tooth is visible in the crop; correct the box before trusting that view.

Apical periodontal inflammation may produce radiographic periapical radiolucency. Granuloma, cyst, abscess and scar cannot be reliably separated from each other by their radiographic appearance alone; retain the permitted Periapical Lesion label rather than inventing a histologic subtype.

Use locate_tooth, zoom_crop and an alignment check before assessing the apex. If the view is misplaced, nudge then re-crop. Use contralateral_compare to investigate asymmetry and window_level for unclear density.
Do not infer percussion tenderness, pain, sinus tracts or pulp vitality from a panoramic image. Clinical apical diagnoses incorporate findings beyond a radiolucency.
